traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets power. Relentless force and a 'win at any cost' edge, with real capacity to eliminate or transform. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Volcanic temper and a tendency to destroy work before it's finished. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Drive and power reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: A conflict can keep looking like a communication problem when the harder issue is who actually controls the terms.

readerCopy.body: A conflict can keep looking like a communication problem when the harder issue is who actually controls the terms. When Mars opposes Pluto, action meets concentrated power through money, access, authority, information, or institutional control. The pressure builds around what gives one side more ability to decide what happens next. More force does not make an unequal position equal. The conflict becomes clearer once the source of control, the remaining alternatives, and the cost of continuing are visible.
